name: question types on, then a URL chip answers it
looks: A question types on character by character in white, with one word landing in an italic accent colour and a blinking cursor at the end. It cuts to a glowing pill-shaped input bar holding a site URL and a small ad-count badge, with four option labels fading up underneath it in a row.
build: DOM text revealed per character at a steady rate with a blinking ::after cursor (kit.typeOn); the accent word sits in an italic face, the rest in the display sans. Hard cut to a bordered pill (rounded, glow via box-shadow) with an icon, mono URL text and a small badge; the four option labels below fade/slide up 4-6px on a short stagger.
sound: A light typing clack per character, a soft confirm tone as the pill appears, a tick per option label.
prompt: Open on a plain question typed on character by character, with one key word picked out in an accent colour and italic. Hard-cut to a glowing input bar holding a short brand-relevant value and a tiny status badge, with a row of short option labels fading up beneath it.
